verdicts.reason: src/reports.ts:7 parses the same zone-less UTC DB column (row.date from the transactions table) with new Date(), so for users outside UTC the value is interpreted as local time and can shift into the previous/next month, corrupting the 'YYYY-MM' bucket key from toISOString().slice(0,7). The identical fix applies: import { parseDate } from "./dates" and use parseDate(row.date). Nothing guards or normalizes the value beforehand, and this is production code, not a test.
